description: Java class 'ServiceConfigProperties' that extends 'ServerConfig'. It serves as a configuration container for server properties such as payload size, tenant mode, logging, connection waiting, message credits, and CORS origins, with getters and setters provided.

classes.name: ServiceConfigProperties
classes.description: A POJO for configuring common properties of server components, with various configuration options such as payload size, tenant mode, logging, connections, credits, and CORS settings.

methods.name: setMaxPayloadSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of a message payload this server accepts from clients.

methods.name: getMaxPayloadSize
methods.description: Gets the maximum size of a message payload this server accepts from clients.

methods.name: isSingleTenant
methods.description: Checks whether the server is configured to run in single-tenant mode.

methods.name: setSingleTenant
methods.description: Sets whether the server should support a single tenant only.

methods.name: isNetworkDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the server is configured to log TCP traffic.

methods.name: setNetworkDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the server should log TCP traffic.

methods.name: isWaitForDownstreamConnectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the server waits for downstream connections to be established during startup.

methods.name: setWaitForDownstreamConnectionEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the server should wait for downstream connections to be established during startup.

methods.name: getReceiverLinkCredit
methods.description: Gets the number of AMQP message credits this service flows to a client when the client opens a sender link to this service.

methods.name: setReceiverLinkCredit
methods.description: Sets the number of AMQP message credits this service flows to a client when the client opens a sender link to this service.

methods.name: getCorsAllowedOrigin
methods.description: Gets the allowed origin pattern for CORS handler.

methods.name: setCorsAllowedOrigin
methods.description: Sets the allowed origin pattern for CORS handler.
